data.description: Welcome to The Valley, a charming new community amid shimmering waters and verdant landscapes.

data.answer:
The Valley, a prestigious residential enclave, is a project of master developer Emaar. Nestled near Dubailand and Expo City, this self-sustaining community boasts many amenities. For retail options, there will be The Pavilion within the community, where residents can conveniently access many fashion outlets and essential services.

Moreover, The Valley is set to introduce a 32,000 sq.m. Town Centre, featuring indoor and outdoor retail spaces, a farmers’ market, and various dining establishments. Designed as an idyllic haven for families, it will offer expansive green spaces, sports courts, and playgrounds, fostering a commitment to eco-friendly living and promoting a healthy lifestyle.

The master plan for The Valley by Emaar includes villa communities and townhouse complexes. Residents can enjoy various activities in the vast outdoor spaces within The Valley Dubai, including jogging trails, parks, playgrounds, and splash parks. This community will also include educational facilities and healthcare services.

Additionally, the community will boast Kids’ Dale, a 10,000 sq. m. dedicated space for kids. The Sports Village in the area consists of cycling tracks, a community gym, and sports courts. The zen and oasis gardens within The Valley provide the perfect sanctuary for yoga and meditation.

Most Popular Buildings in The Valley

Properties available for sale in The Valley Dubai present lucrative opportunities for investors. Home seekers can select from various residences, including 3- to 5-bedroom villas and townhouses. These units cover areas ranging from 1,988 sq. ft. to 2,311 sq. ft.

The properties are distributed across nine distinct communities, some of which have already been completed while others are currently under development. Delivered in 2023, Eden marks the inaugural phase within The Valley. The villas in Eden, The Valley Dubai, offer 3 and 4-bedroom units.

Off-Plan Projects in The Valley

As per The Valley master plan, many projects are in the pipeline within the area. Here is the list of the top off-plan properties in the community.

Lillia The Valley: The opulent new homes in The Valley range from 3 to 4 bedrooms. It features an outdoor play area, a fitness center and a social clubhouse.

Farm Gardens 2: Immerse yourself in the unparalleled charm of Farm Gardens 2, a project by Emaar Properties strategically positioned in  The Valley. 

Alana The Valley: Positioned within The Valley community in Dubai, Alana by Emaar Properties emerges as a prestigious development, offering an unrivaled standard of living. 

Nima The Valley: Set within the picturesque landscapes of The Valley by Emaar, Nima offers 3 to 4-bedroom townhouses.

Farm Gardens is a chic development in Dubai with a country feel. A project by Emaar Properties, It features 4 to 5-bedroom villas.

Orania at The Valley: Orania at The Valley presents clusters of 3 and 4-bedroom residences, with options available in two distinct styles: Bold and Sleek.

Rivana: It offers twin villas with 3 to 5 bedrooms, prices starting from AED 2.8 million. Buyers can choose between two architectural themes: Kai and Clara.

Elora The Valley: The Valley is a lovely new neighbourhood comprised of contemporary 3 and 4-bedroom townhouse complexes inspired by the vast shimmering sands and lush green open areas. 

Nara: Nara comprises 3- to 4-bedroom townhomes in three unique architectural designs: Aston, Palma, and Charm.

Talia: The project showcases 3-bedroom and 4-bedroom townhouses in three architectural designs: Pharo, Cyrus, and Elio.

Property for Rent in The Valley

Interested in The Valley Dubai rental properties? The townhouses in The Valley are available for rent starting from AED 135k. Only the townhouses in the Eden community are available for rent in the Valley. These homes are in a prime location in the middle of The Valley Gate and The Pavilion.

Property for Sale in The Valley Area

Buyers looking for properties for sale in The Valley Dubai, can invest in villas and townhouses ranging from 3 to 5 bedrooms. A 3-bedroom villa in The Valley Dubai for sale is available for a minimum of AED 1.8 million, while larger 4-bedroom villas The Valley price is AED 2.1 million.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in The Valley?

data.answer:
Life in The Valley offers a harmonious blend of tranquility and modern convenience. Nestled amidst expansive green spaces and shimmering sands, it offers a serene environment away from the city's hustle and bustle. Residents can enjoy various facilities like parks, playgrounds, sports areas, and retail centers.

Transportation in The Valley 

Note that the public transportation options near The Valley are still limited. However, you can drive to the neighboring areas where multiple bus stations are accessible. Parking is a breeze at The Valley Emaar, with each villa and townhouse equipped with a dedicated facility accommodating two cars. 

Supermarkets in The Valley Area

The closest grocery store for residents of The Valley is Carrefour, about 13 minutes away. It is located in the neighboring DAMAC Hills 2. 

Shopping Malls in The Valley

Two prominent shopping malls near The Valley are Dubai Outlet Mall and Cityland Mall. Cityland Mall is within a 22-minute drive, and families can explore The Garden, a sustainable space, an outlet of Carrefour, and numerous retail stores.

Schools in The Valley Dubai

Ranches Primary School, which follows the National Curriculum of England, serves as a nearby primary education option for residents of The Valley. It takes approximately 20 minutes to reach the school by car.

For higher education opportunities, Academic City, home to various institutes, is conveniently located within a 17-minute drive. Residents can easily access Academic City via the Al Ain – Dubai (E66) route, which runs adjacent to the area.

Churches, Temples and Mosques in The Valley Area 

For residents seeking nearby places of worship, mosques are accessible with a drive of approximately 20 to 22 minutes. Among the closest options are Al Salam Masjid and Masjid Hussain Abdullah Albahri.

Clinics and Hospitals in The Valley 

Residents of The Valley can rely on the nearby Dubai London Clinic and HealthHub Clinic for medical assistance. These clinics are conveniently located just a short drive away from the community.

The Valley Emaar Location & Nearby Areas

The Valley offers residents easy access to key areas of the emirate, including Academic City and Silicon Oasis. DAMAC Hills 2 is a mere 14-minute drive away, while Arabian Ranches 2 can be reached in 25 minutes. Other neighboring areas include The Villa and Al Barari. Rashid Yachts & Marina is also located close to the area.

more_info.question: Things to Do in The Valley Dubai Location

data.answer:
Residents at The Valley by Emaar can engage in various recreational activities such as jogging along scenic trails, picnicking in lush parks, or playing sports at the community's sports facilities. Additionally, they can explore the nearby retail centers, dine at local eateries, or simply enjoy the tranquility of the surroundings for a relaxing day out.

The Valley Area Restaurants and Bars

Residents looking for dining options can drive to the neighboring areas or nearest malls. A few popular restaurants near the Valley Dubai are Chuck E Cheese,  Burger King, and Al Khawabi.

Beaches Near The Valley Location

Visiting Dubai beaches would take an hour-long drive as the coastline is far from the development. Families can head to the Secret Beach or visit the Beach JBR for watersports activities.

Attractions and Landmarks in The Valley

Dubai Outlet Mall, an ideal retail destination in the city, is close to The Valley. Moreover,  the Sevens Stadium is one of the top sports stadiums in Dubai, located a short drive away from the community. It is a gigantic multi-purpose stadium that hosts sporting and other events throughout the year. IMG Worlds of Adventure is another leisure spot at an 18-minute drive home to several 3D rides and cinema halls. Al Qudra cycle tracks and Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club are other leisure spots nearby.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

The residential community has lush green open spaces that promote a healthy lifestyle among residents. There is a sports village, a kid’s dale, and a town center with plenty of recreational facilities, such as jogging tracks, fitness centers, and dining options.

While The Valley Dubai offers numerous advantages, there is something you need to consider before moving in. Public transportation options near The Valley are limited, requiring residents to rely primarily on private vehicles for commuting.

When was The Valley launched?

Emaar announced The Valley in November 2019

Is The Valley a gated community?

Yes, The Valley is a gated community, providing security and privacy to its residents.

Are there any hotels in The Valley location?

No, there are no hotels in Emaar The Valley location so far, but as upcoming developments or expansions are planned for The Valley, we can expect more leisure options and hotels to open in the area.

What types of properties are available in The Valley?

The Valley offers a variety of residential properties including villas, townhouses, and apartments. Some popular communities within The Valley are Eden, Talia, and Nara, each featuring modern designs and spacious layouts to cater to different family sizes and preferences.

Are there any schools in The Valley?

Yes, there are several schools in and near The Valley. Some of the prominent schools include The Valley School, GEMS International School, and Dubai British School, offering various curriculums such as British, American, and International Baccalaureate.

Are there any hospitals or clinics in The Valley?

Yes, there are medical facilities such as hospitals and clinics within and around The Valley. Notable healthcare centers include Mediclinic Parkview Hospital, Emirates Hospital, and The Valley Health Clinic, providing comprehensive medical services from general practice to specialized care.

What recreational facilities are available in The Valley?

The Valley offers numerous recreational facilities including parks, playgrounds, sports courts, swimming pools, and fitness centers. Popular recreational spots include Golden Beach, Town Centre, and The Pavilion, which host various activities and events to promote a healthy and active lifestyle for residents.

Is public transportation available in The Valley?

Yes, public transportation options such as buses and taxis are available in The Valley. The area is well-connected to the rest of Dubai, making commuting convenient for residents. The Dubai Metro extension and planned bus routes are expected to further enhance public transportation infrastructure.

Are there any shopping malls near The Valley?

Yes, there are several shopping malls near The Valley. Notable malls include Dubai Mall, Mall of the Emirates, and City Centre Mirdif, offering a wide range of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment facilities for convenient access to shopping and leisure activities.

What attractions are near The Valley?

The Valley is in proximity to several notable attractions in Dubai. Popular nearby attractions include Dubai Miracle Garden, Global Village, and Dubai Autodrome, offering residents ample opportunities for leisure and family outings.
Check out The Valley area map to learn more about its location.

data.content:
Emaar launched The Valley in November 2019, a green neighborhood offering a tranquil lifestyle with excellent leisure activities at your doorstep. Once completed, The Valley will boast fantastic lifestyle amenities, including a 30,000 sq. m. Golden Beach and 20,000 sq. m. Sports Village, Kids Dale Town Center, and Pocket Park.

Situated on the outskirts of Dubai, the neighborhood is nestled along the Dubai—Al Ain Road (E66), a vital thoroughfare linking Sharjah and Dubai.

Located in Dubailand's lush green surroundings, The Valley is a self-sustaining residential community of villas and townhouses. It offers prospective buyers a plethora of attractive investment opportunities and ensures all-encompassing urban conveniences for families.

nodes.title: Ovelle
nodes.about:
Ovelle at The Valley introduces a serene collection of 133 villas designed for mindful living, offering expansive 4 and 5-bedroom layouts in a nature-inspired community. The development blends contemporary architecture with earthy palettes, lush landscapes, flowing water, and sunlit interiors to create a calming residential experience.

Set within The Valley’s tranquil surroundings, Ovelle by Emaar Properties offers open-plan layouts, outdoor–indoor integration, and access to thoughtful amenities including a village market plaza, falaj fountain, canopy walk, and dedicated fitness areas. With a 10% down payment and strong long-term ROI potential, the project presents a compelling opportunity for end-users and investors alike.

nodes.title: Avelia
nodes.about:
Avelia at The Valley by Emaar is the newest premium villa cluster in The Valley, a master community designed around harmony, greenery, and open spaces. Offering 4-bedroom, 5-bedroom Luxury, and 5-bedroom Premium villas, Avelia blends contemporary architecture with wide plot sizes, airy layouts, private gardens, and multi-level living spaces. Inspired by Emirati wadis, the community incorporates water elements, walking trails, themed parks, and communal green areas that foster calm, creativity, and an active outdoor lifestyle.

From Plateau Views and The Plantations to Central Park and Village Plaza, Avelia residents enjoy a holistic environment perfect for families who value balance and wellness. With exceptional connectivity to Dubai’s key districts, generous villa proportions, and a handover scheduled for December 2029, Avelia is an investment in refined living and long-term capital appreciation.
